A '''rogue military force''' was formed in [[7 ABY/Legends|7.5 ABY]]<ref name="New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> when most of the members of the celebrated [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] resigned from the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[New Republic Starfighter Command/Legends|military]] in order to liberate [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]] from the grasp of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Director of Imperial Intelligence|Director of Intelligence]] [[Ysanne Isard|Ysanne Isard.]] 

The planet had recently undergone a coup that left the [[Xucphra Corporation]] in charge of its resources and with it the production of the life-saving medical fluid [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]], Isard's allies in Xucphra then elected her the head of the company, placing her in charge of the galaxy's supply of the medicine. Not coincidentally, the New Republic was in desperate need of large amounts of bacta to combat the devastating [[Krytos virus]], 

Despite this, the New Republic government refused to sanction a military response due to political considerations.

Unable to accept this, [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] resigned his commission. Leader [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and almost the entire squadron quickly followed suit. The only exception was [[Pash Cracken]], who had wished to do so but Antilles politely discouraged this as [[Airen Cracken/Legends|his father's]] position in the government meant that his involvement would be taken as evidence of Republic support. 

Unrestrained by the government's decision, they then began the campaign that became known as the [[Bacta War]].<ref name="The Bacta War" />
